items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: After the Bhote Koshi floods, 626 bodies have been recovered and about 2400 people are still unaccounted for. Over 4450 people have been rescued, including more than 187 foreign nationals.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, killing many and leaving others missing. So far 538 bodies have been recovered and 511 people are still unaccounted for.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue teams are working at the mudslide site in Gyirong Port, where three people have been reported killed, 558 are missing, and two villagers have been rescued as of Thursday morning.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
